title: Home and open-ended applications
description: The inherited opening now leads to six broad work areas and an open invitation to configure the platform for another workflow.
components: 01.1 Page navigation

Preserve the floating capsule and original logo. Home, Products, Services, About and Updates are page links, followed by language and Talk to our team. Use aria-current=page, visible keyboard focus and a clear active state. No homepage chapter names in the primary menu.
01.2 Opening
Keep the exact headline: Put AI to work across your organization. Name Core Agentic immediately. Preserve the current large type, navy canvas, #044EFF emphasis and blue corner waves.
01.3 Two actions
Talk to our team opens Contact. Explore applications moves within Home to #applications. Preserve pill proportions; stack full-width controls on phones.
01.4 Connected work

Native request, agents, Core Agentic, approved systems and reviewable-output diagram. This is an illustrative workflow, not a live product screenshot. Adapt connectors to actual node positions; smaller screens use a concise vertical flow.
01.5 Work areas

Six examples: Sales & customer support, Knowledge & research, Internal operations, Finance & reconciliation, People & HR, Documents & legal. These describe organizational work rather than six separately sold products.
01.6 Shared foundation

All examples connect to knowledge, agents, tools and controls. SupportHub/KnowledgeHub/LegalHub are contextual examples, not fixed platform pillars. Separate VisionHub/FamilyHub/EduAssess products stay outside this foundation.
01.7 Your workflow

An open-ended final tile invites the visitor to describe their actual workflow. Link to Contact with workflow context. The six visible examples are a starting set, not a ceiling on what the platform can be configured to support.
01.8 Scenario detail

Below the cards, retain a native selectable example: request, approved sources, agent work, human review and usable output. Wide screens use accessible tabs; narrow screens use a labeled selector. Preserve sales/research/internal-operations deep links and reading position when changing selection.

title: Value, working proof and control
description: The existing value, delivery and control design remains part of the homepage, with the new page-level topbar.
components: 02.1 Outcomes
Productivity and economics lead. Supporting consistency, agility and transparency explain why the operational changes matter without claiming perfect accuracy or universally cheaper delivery.
02.2 Illustrative effort model

Preserve the actual model: before = 60 eligible + 40 other minutes; after = 12 eligible + 40 other + 8 review = 60 minutes. The resulting 40% effort reduction is illustrative, never a customer result.
02.3 Editable assumptions

Adjust the assumptions expands the existing worksheet inline at #business-value. Keep validation, reset, optional total-cost assumptions and unfavorable outcomes. The chapter grows; it must not clip or prevent scrolling. Closing returns focus to its trigger.
02.4 Core Agentic process

Keep six stages: agree the opportunity, define the proof, build together, evaluate, put into operation and expand. Include training/operating handoff. This is the platform working-proof narrative, distinct from the Services page's five-stage engineering process.
02.5 Session brief
Show process owner, approved information and success measures. Preserve intent=working-session in the Contact action.
02.6 Knowledge and control
Retain source → agent/tool work → checkpoint → visible result. Detailed access, approvals and history expand within #control instead of opening a separate Trust page.
02.7 Motion and states

Use subtle existing reveals and restrained diagram activity; pause offscreen loops. Review, exception and pending states need text/icons as well as color. Reduced-motion mode shows stable complete states.

title: Real organizations, custom services and Updates
description: Eight customers, four separately labeled partners, the restored custom-development invitation and the editorial closing.
components: 03.1 Customers

Ajinomoto, Nidec, FPT Automotive, VTI Solutions, RAIS Tech, Ymner, TNE and NEU — National Economics University. Text names are acceptable in these concept boards; the real build must use authentic logo images. Do not label every relationship a Core Agentic deployment.
03.2 Partners
Intel, Microsoft, Google and Techvico form a separately labeled group. Preserve each brand's actual artwork and proportions rather than generating marks or applying the primary blue to every logo.
03.3 Logo treatment

Use a calm optical-size grid on light surfaces; four columns on wide screens, fewer as space permits and two on phones. Natural aspect ratio, contain fitting, full accessible organization name. Missing Ymner/TNE files remain explicit asset tasks; see logo-assets.json and logo-assets.html.
03.4 Custom-services invitation

Custom AI. Built for your business. Introduce bespoke agents, workflow automation, APIs, model adaptation, AI products and strategy. This is a substantive second offer, linked to /services; it is not merely a line about installing Core Agentic.
03.5 Updates teaser

From Primitive AI previews three editorial concepts. Draft titles in the mockup are not published articles. The real teaser is driven by approved content; with no posts, use a concise introduction and the official company channel instead of fabricated cards.
03.6 Closing
Preserve the existing navy/blue-wave invitation and focused contact action. Avoid unsupported customer percentages and the removed anonymous case-story collection.
03.7 Footer
Use the same page destinations as the topbar, Contact, Privacy, Terms and original LinkedIn. Optional contextual homepage anchors can be secondary. Email stays doannt@primitive-ai.com everywhere.

title: About and the fuller original journey
description: A founder-led company story with the concrete named product path restored, culminating in Core Agentic.
components: 04.1 Founder hero

Retain More potential. More productive organizations. and the authentic Doan Nguyen portrait. The production image is public/founders/doannt-body.png, not the generated rendering. Founder only; no invented team members.
04.2 Founding fact
Primitive AI was founded in 2023 per the owner. 2016 describes personal learning. The older file's 2020 company-founding statement must not return.
04.3 Founding question

Restore the original motivation and concrete FDI/Vietnamese operating context. A question that stayed with us is an editorial treatment of the existing narrative, not a sourced customer quote or independent economic claim.
04.4 Fuller path

2016 learning → early VisionHub/computer vision → 2023 company formation → SupportHub/response quality → KnowledgeHub, memory and custom services → LegalHub/documents → FamilyHub & EduAssess wider applications → Core Agentic. Preserve the original detailed source material for expansion. Product stages are undated lineage, not new verified launch dates.
04.5 Timeline design

A connected vertical path with distinct named milestone cards. Keep meaningful descriptions visible; optional More detail expands inline. The final Core Agentic node has the strongest blue emphasis. Remove the generic Applied AI foundations stage entirely.
04.6 Principles
Restore Customer First, Excellence, Innovation and Responsibility in the inherited rounded-card style, with concrete supporting copy during implementation.
04.7 Catalog link

About links to Products and Services without duplicating their complete catalogs. VisionHub/FamilyHub/EduAssess retain independent product identities. Standard reading scroll, not presentation snapping through the chronology.

title: Phone, tablet and the page menu
description: A stacked phone opening, open page-level mobile menu and readable tablet applications layout.
components: 05.1 Phone opening
Compact logo/menu header, fluid headline, stacked actions and vertical request → Core Agentic → approved systems → result summary. Let tall content continue below the fold.
05.2 Open menu

Home, Products, Services, About, Updates and Talk to our team. Menu button exposes expanded state and controls the menu; Escape and navigation close it and restore focus where appropriate. The menu scrolls internally on short viewports so the contact and language controls remain reachable. Use at least 44 px targets. Homepage chapter links do not reappear as competing main menu entries.
05.3 Tablet header

Collapse to logo/contact/menu when the five page labels no longer fit comfortably. Do not shrink a desktop navigation bar into tiny labels. Determine the transition by available space and translated-label length.
05.4 Application reflow

Six examples use three columns where a wide tablet has room, two on narrower tablets and one on phones. Shared connectors reorient; no fixed-width canvas or clipped horizontal card strip. Your workflow remains available after the examples.
05.5 Relationship subset
The compact view shows a subset only; all eight customer records remain reachable vertically. The full accessible name for NEU is National Economics University. Partners retain their own label.
05.6 Short screens and motion

Natural content heights at landscape widths and text zoom; native proximity snapping only where it aids reading. Expanded sections remain scrollable. Reduced-motion mode preserves complete content. This image is a design state, not proof of browser/device testing.

title: Products and the shared platform
description: Core Agentic is the flagship. The three independent specialist products remain visible without confusing the platform's configurable applications.
components: 06.1 Products masthead
A shorter inherited navy masthead introduces the catalog without repeating the whole homepage. Active header item is Products.
06.2 Flagship
Core Agentic leads with its shared knowledge/agents/tools/controls diagram, a concise enterprise proposition and a Home link to the full story. Reuse existing native diagram components.
06.3 Applications

Generic work-area chips/examples show breadth. Sales/support, operations, knowledge/research, finance, HR and documents are configurations. SupportHub/KnowledgeHub/LegalHub are contextual lineage examples, not separate top-level products here.
06.4 Separate offerings

Three distinct cards: VisionHub (computer vision in operating environments), FamilyHub (family knowledge and memory), EduAssess (English language assessment). They are explicitly outside the Core Agentic ecosystem. Preserve useful existing product/app links; no invented active/beta status or new capabilities.
06.5 Custom-build bridge
Need something tailored? links to /services and its custom-development contact intent. Keep a product-first visitor's next step clear while exposing the engineering offer.
06.6 Routing

The /products split is recommended for this review. Existing specialist paths can remain in the shared template until any replacement is reviewed. Do not touch application, login or API routes as a side effect of catalog migration.

title: Custom AI Development services
description: The complete original service offer returns, with six capabilities, useful deliverables and a practical engineering process.
components: 07.1 Services opening
Custom AI. Built for your business. explicitly presents bespoke AI engineering. The active topbar item is Services. Primary CTA Discuss your project opens Contact with intent=custom-development.
07.2 Two starting paths
Configure Core Agentic for a workflow, or develop custom AI for a tailored requirement. A custom project need not use Core Agentic; do not force every engagement into the platform story.
07.3 Six capabilities

AI Agent Development; AI Workflow Automation; AI API Development; Model Training & Fine-Tuning; AI Product Development; Consulting & Strategy. Retain all original areas, with concise practical outcomes and optional examples rather than unsupported guarantees.
07.4 Deliverable focus

Describe the scoped workflow/application, approved information and systems, task evaluation, exceptions/review requirements and deployment/operating handoff. These are engagement topics to agree, not a fixed universal package.
07.5 Engineering process

Restore Discovery → Strategy → Build → Deploy → Optimize from the original Services page. Use connected horizontal steps on wide screens and numbered vertical rows on phones. Keep this distinct from the six-stage Core Agentic working-proof story on Home.
07.6 Inquiry context

Discuss your project retains the service intent and any chosen capability in the inquiry. Existing email-draft interaction remains honest; recipient doannt@primitive-ai.com. No new external submission service is implied.
07.7 Source restraint

Do not carry forward original marketing counts, unqualified 24/7 autonomy, accuracy promises or guaranteed integrations without evidence. Use real approved delivery examples only when their scope is clear.

title: Updates and offering-aware Contact
description: The editorial and inquiry design retains its current visual language, with canonical /update and context for custom-development inquiries.
components: 08.1 Updates index

The public path is /update; the label is Updates. Keep a compact navy masthead, readable cards and filtering only when actual content exists. All, Company, Core Agentic, Services and Other products are useful categories.
08.2 Editorial cards

Preview titles are design drafts with no invented dates. Do not convert removed anonymous cases into articles. With zero published posts, show the editorial introduction and real company channel; never a false archive.
08.3 Article reading

A later real article uses a quiet reading template, meaningful headings, original source/date/author when known and ordinary scrolling. No presentation snap through paragraphs. /update/:slug is reserved for actual approved records.
08.4 Contact introduction
Bring us a workflow worth improving. still works for both platform and custom engineering inquiries. Use Project or workflow for the description field.
08.5 Offering context

Optional Interested in: Core Agentic, Custom AI development, Specialist products. A Services link preselects Custom AI development. Keep name/email/organization/project requirements, optional systems/frequency, input preservation, clear errors and error focus.
08.6 Honest submission
Prepare email draft creates a draft addressed to doannt@primitive-ai.com. Success describes the prepared draft, not receipt by Primitive AI. Preserve current fallback/copy behavior and query context.
08.7 Company details
+84 338 710 391; +1 917 508 5261. US: 2261 Market Street STE 22919, San Francisco, CA 94114. Vietnam: No 04, 98/17 Lane, Tan Trieu, Thanh Liet, Hanoi, Vietnam. Original company LinkedIn only.
08.8 Responsive and shared UI

Forms stack on phones, labels stay above inputs and details remain in natural reading order. Use the same page-level header/footer on every page. All text and controls are native UI in the implementation.
